## What's Changed

### New Features

- Added a persistent Logs setting to hide local network IPs from Dashboard statistics, the access map, Top IPs, and protection events while retaining them in access logs.
- Added automatic external blocklist refreshes at startup and every 24 hours.

### Optimizations

- Made the dashboard and administration views more compact, including denser tables, forms, navigation, and controls.
- Displayed recent protection events as concise single-line entries.

### Bug Fixes

- Preserved external blocklist counters when adding a new feed and aligned the list table columns.
- Converted pasted GitHub blob URLs into direct raw-content feed URLs.
